faq.question: What is the turnaround time for candidate shortlists?
faq.answer: For permanent direct-hire placement, Venus presents a calibrated candidate shortlist within 3 to 5 business days. For contract staffing, technical contractors can be onboarded within 48 hours.

faq.question: Does Venus offer a placement guarantee?
faq.answer: Yes. Venus Consultancy provides a written full replacement guarantee on permanent placements.

faq.question: How does Venus screen technical candidates?
faq.answer: 100% of technical candidates undergo code-verified technical assessments, structural behavioral interviews, and thorough background/reference checks before presentation.

faq.question: Does Venus assist with Canadian work permits and LMIA?
faq.answer: Yes. Through our Fractional HR & Advisory practice, Venus provides guidance on Canadian LMIA applications, Express Entry transitions, and work permit compliance.

faq.question: Is there any fee for job seekers or candidates?
faq.answer: No. All Venus recruitment services are 100% free for job candidates. Hiring employers pay all recruitment fees.
